selection: Only source-bound reviews, reports, JSON receipts, logs, audited code/evidence and previous public-source records. No environment dumps, credentials, actual private document content, database/profile, node_modules or full screenshot ZIP payloads included. Task worktree paths in original reports are retained for provenance. Pattern scan supplements this bounded selection; it is not a universal secret detector.
